# Additional tables {#sec-appendix-tables}

Appendix chapters are listed under `appendices:` in `_quarto.yml`. They are
lettered rather than numbered, so tables and figures in this one are
numbered A.1, A.2 and so on. The code that makes @tbl-descriptives is hidden
with `#| echo: false`, as it usually would be in a thesis.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-descriptives
#| tbl-cap: "Descriptive statistics, 50 countries, averages for 1960 to 1970"
#| tbl-pos: "H"
#| echo: false
#| message: false

library(modelsummary)

savings <- LifeCycleSavings
savings$dpi_k <- savings$dpi / 1000

datasummary(
  (`Savings ratio (%)` = sr) +
    (`Population under 15 (%)` = pop15) +
    (`Population over 75 (%)` = pop75) +
    (`Disposable income per head (thousands)` = dpi_k) +
    (`Growth of disposable income (%)` = ddpi) ~
    Mean + SD + Min + Max,
  data = savings
)
```
